lines: ==> PS5 RetroArch XMB preview capture: args.txt --ps5-capture=600 with --appendconfig (1920x1080, aspect 16:9, no config save)
before the fix (build ce576f3d): capture: frame 600 of 600, viewport 1920x1080, read_viewport -> ok; PPM 1920x1080 garbled
garbled PPM: written rows are 1440 pixels (rows 1440 apart differ by 0.92 on average; 1,555,200 = 1440x1080 pixels written); top quarter black
cause: vulkan_read_viewport writes min(viewport, video size) rows; the video size was 1440x1080 (aspect index 22, core-provided 4:3 with no core); patch 0031 wrote the PPM at the viewport size
fix (tools/apply-port-patches.py, 0031): the PPM takes min(vp, video) width and height, as read_viewport writes
after the fix (build 10a24fa1, build/ra-conf recreated): capture: frame 600 of 600, viewport 1920x1080, read_viewport -> ok (/app0/xmb-preview.ppm)
clean capture: 1920x1080, black rows 0, png sha256 45717b63754aa739b8ea526ac59b0069b9b890f1ce956175aa87629242639ec0
config/retroarch.cfg unchanged by both capture runs (sha256 785579484698f8e2...)
